meta.title: Validated Burke-pentad × Calleja-PIM crosswalk
meta.method: bidirectional validation of two independently-authored one-directional anticipatory tables (gm-pentad §E ; ig-pim §E.1) against each other and both source texts
meta.provenance_note: All pentad<->PIM bindings are anticipatory-projection (neither Burke nor Calleja makes the cross-claim). Validation upgrades epistemic status from one-directional guess to bidirectionally-warranted; it does not make them author claims.

status_legend.validated: asserted in both directions (or one + clear textual support on the other)
status_legend.extended: added by the Rhetoric pipeline; not available to the Grammar-only pass
status_legend.revised: binding holds but rescoped (primary->secondary, or split)

axes.dynamics_layer: the 10 dramatistic ratios (Grammar) operate between cells; Attitude is a transverse modifier on all five placement-terms
axes.synthesis_construct: Incorporation (Calleja IG-10 p.169) <-> Consubstantiation (Burke RM-01 p.21)

resolved_divergence.name: the Ludic split
resolved_divergence.resolution: Split the Ludic dimension along Burke's own Agency/Act cut: (a) the rule-SYSTEM (mechanics, cooldowns, economy) = Agency; (b) the act of CHOOSING-under-repercussion = Act + Purpose. The DIA method treats these as two distinct grid cells.
resolved_divergence.significance: a refinement the fusion produces that neither framework states alone

secondary_ties.note: physical-execution pole of Act; subordinate to Agency<->Kinesthetic
mastery / affect-regulation drive behind a goal; subordinate to Attitude<->Affective

keystone.name: Consubstantiation <-> Incorporation
keystone.level: synthesis-construct (vertical binding above the term-by-dimension grid)
keystone.now: RM-01 p.21 supplies burke-direct text; rm-identification-consubstantiation-manual §D consolidates

homology.burke: A is substantially one with the other (p.21)
yet remains a distinct locus of motives (p.21)
homology.calleja: R2 embodiment axis (player INTO world via avatar)

homology.burke: both joined AND separate, held simultaneously (p.21)
ultimate identification — dissolution into boundless being (RM-07 p.333)

keystone.note: homology, not equation; functional not lexical (Burke never says 'embodiment', Calleja never says 'substance')
